```{r}

library(here)
library(drc) # modeling tools
library(tidyverse) # your go to set of functions for messing w/data
library(RColorBrewer) # to make color schemes
#library(ggpubr) # publication quality ggplots ha ha ha
library(ggthemes) # additional themes for ggplot-ing
library(gridExtra) # allows arranging of plots (rows/columns...)
library(splitstackshape)
library(ggpubr)
library(readxl)

df <- read_excel(here::here("data", "DLAssay_ALLData.xlsx"))


data_summary <- function(data, varname, groupnames){
  require(plyr)
  summary_func <- function(x, col){
    c(mean = mean(x[[col]], na.rm=TRUE),
      sd = sd(x[[col]], na.rm=TRUE))
  }
  data_sum<-ddply(data, groupnames, .fun=summary_func,
                  varname)
  data_sum <- rename(data_sum, c("mean" = varname))
 return(data_sum)
}
```


# Figure 1C - OG Tether experiments

```{r}
construct_order <- c(
  "328 tethered",
  "GFP tethered",
  "328 No Tether",
  "GFP No Tether"
)

df_kab152 <- df %>%
  filter(Exp == "KAB152") %>%
  mutate(
    Nano_FF = NanoGlo / Firefly,
    construct_plot = case_when(
      MSI2_Exp %in% c("328_Tether", "WT_Tether", "FullLength_Tether") ~ "328 tethered",
      MSI2_Exp == "GFP_Tether" ~ "GFP tethered",
      MSI2_Exp %in% c("328_NoTether", "WT_NoTether", "FullLength_NoTether") ~ "328 No Tether",
      MSI2_Exp == "GFP_NoTether" ~ "GFP No Tether",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(construct_plot)) %>%
  mutate(
    construct_plot = factor(construct_plot, levels = construct_order)
  )

# normalize everything to GFP tethered
gfp_tether_mean <- df_kab152 %>%
  filter(construct_plot == "GFP tethered") %>%
  summarise(mean_gfp = mean(Nano_FF, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(mean_gfp)

df_norm <- df_kab152 %>%
  mutate(Norm = Nano_FF / gfp_tether_mean)


#stats
df_stats <- df_norm %>%
  filter(construct_plot != "GFP tethered") %>%
  group_by(construct_plot) %>%
  summarise(
    GFP_tether_mean = mean(df_norm$Norm[df_norm$construct_plot == "GFP tethered"], na.rm = TRUE),
    construct_mean = mean(Norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    FC_vs_GFP_tether = construct_mean / GFP_tether_mean,
    p_value = tryCatch(
      t.test(
        Norm,
        df_norm$Norm[df_norm$construct_plot == "GFP tethered"],
        alternative = "two.sided",
        var.equal = FALSE
      )$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    FC_label = paste0(round(FC_vs_GFP_tether, 2), "x"),
    p_label = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "p_adj < 0.001",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "p_adj < 0.01",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "p_adj < 0.05",
      TRUE ~ paste0("p_adj = ", signif(p_adj, 2))
    ),
    sig_label = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  )

df_stats

df_summary <- df_norm %>%
  group_by(construct_plot) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(Norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(Norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(df_stats, by = "construct_plot")

fig1 <- ggplot(df_summary, aes(x = construct_plot, y = mean)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "red") +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = ifelse(
        construct_plot == "GFP tethered",
        "",
        paste0(FC_label, "\n", sig_label)
      ),
      y = mean + sd + 0.15
    ),
    size = 4
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 8)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "NanoLuc:Firefly normalized to GFP tethered",
    title = "KAB152 method proof"
  )

ggsave(here::here("figures", "fig1C_DLmethodProof.pdf"))

```

# Fig 1D - qPCR data
```{r}
OD4 <- read_csv(here::here("data", "KAB152_Reps2-3.csv"))
OD4 <- OD4[,c(3,5)]

OD4 <- OD4 %>% separate(col = "Sample", into = c("Sample",  "Rep", "RT", "Primer"), sep = "_" )
OD4 <- OD4 %>% tidyr::unite("Sample", c("Sample", "Rep", "RT"), remove = FALSE)  %>% na.omit()

df_qpcr_clean <- OD4 %>%
  filter(RT == "RT") %>%                 # keep only +RT samples
  filter(!str_detect(Sample, "H2O|H20|NTC")) %>%
  select(Sample, Rep, RT, Primer, Cq) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Primer,
    values_from = Cq,
    values_fn = mean
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    deltaCt = Nano - FF,
    expression = 2^(-deltaCt),
    construct_plot = case_when(
      str_detect(Sample, "WT28Tether|328Tether") ~ "328 tethered",
      str_detect(Sample, "GFPTether") ~ "GFP tethered",
      str_detect(Sample, "WT28NT|328NT") ~ "328 No Tether",
      str_detect(Sample, "GFPNT") ~ "GFP No Tether",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(construct_plot)) %>%
  mutate(
    construct_plot = factor(
      construct_plot,
      levels = c(
        "328 tethered",
        "GFP tethered",
        "328 No Tether",
        "GFP No Tether"
      )
    )
  )

gfp_tether_mean <- df_qpcr_clean %>%
  filter(construct_plot == "GFP tethered") %>%
  summarise(mean_gfp = mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(mean_gfp)

df_qpcr_norm <- df_qpcr_clean %>%
  mutate(Norm = expression / gfp_tether_mean)

df_qpcr_stats <- df_qpcr_norm %>%
  filter(construct_plot != "GFP tethered") %>%
  group_by(construct_plot) %>%
  summarise(
    FC_vs_GFP_tether = mean(Norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    p_value = tryCatch(
      t.test(
        Norm,
        df_qpcr_norm$Norm[df_qpcr_norm$construct_plot == "GFP tethered"]
      )$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    sig_label = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    ),
    label = paste0(round(FC_vs_GFP_tether, 2), "x\n", sig_label)
  )

df_qpcr_stats

df_qpcr_summary <- df_qpcr_norm %>%
  group_by(construct_plot) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(Norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(Norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(df_qpcr_stats, by = "construct_plot")

ggplot(df_qpcr_summary, aes(x = construct_plot, y = mean)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "red") +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = ifelse(construct_plot == "GFP tethered", "", label),
      y = mean + sd + 0.2
    ),
    size = 4
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 8)) +   # 👈 MATCH THIS
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Relative RNA expression (normalized to GFP tethered)"
  )

ggsave(here::here("figures", "fig1D_qPCRmethodProof.pdf"))

```



# Figure 1F - KD experiments

```{r}

df_kd_wt <- df %>%
  filter(Exp %in% c("KAB151", "KAB153", "KAB154")) %>%
  mutate(
    Nano_FF = NanoGlo / Firefly,
    Background = case_when(
      str_detect(Cell_Line, "^WT") | MSI2_Exp == "WT" ~ "WT",
      str_detect(Cell_Line, "^KD") | MSI2_Exp == "KD" ~ "KD",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Cell = case_when(
      str_detect(Cell_Line, "H295R") ~ "H295R",
      str_detect(Cell_Line, "HEK") ~ "HEK",
      str_detect(Cell_Line, "HeLa") ~ "HeLa",
      TRUE ~ Cell_Line
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Background),
    MSI2_Exp %in% c("WT", "KD"),     # removes rescues / dox / 328 constructs
    !is.na(Reporter),
    Reporter != "NA"
  )



#normalize within experiment + cell line + reporter to the WT mean
df_norm <- df_kd_wt %>%
  group_by(Exp, Cell, Reporter) %>%
  mutate(
    WT_mean = mean(Nano_FF[Background == "WT"], na.rm = TRUE),
    Norm = Nano_FF / WT_mean
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(Norm), is.finite(Norm))

#Plot WT vs KD, faceted by cell line:
df_summary <- df_norm %>%
  group_by(Cell, Reporter, Background) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(Norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(Norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(df_summary, aes(x = Reporter, y = mean, fill = Background)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge()) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd),
    width = 0.2,
    position = position_dodge(0.9)
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "red") +
  facet_wrap(~Cell) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "NanoLuc:Firefly normalized to WT",
    title = "WT vs KD background"
  )

ggplot(df_summary %>% filter(Reporter == "Syn" | Reporter == "SCD"), aes(x = Reporter, y = mean, fill = Background)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge()) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd),
    width = 0.2,
    position = position_dodge(0.9)
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "red") +
  facet_wrap(~Cell) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "NanoLuc:Firefly normalized to WT",
    title = "WT vs KD background"
  )

#need stats
df_stats <- df_norm %>%
  filter(Background %in% c("WT", "KD")) %>%
  group_by(Cell, Reporter) %>%
  summarise(
    WT_mean = mean(Norm[Background == "WT"], na.rm = TRUE),
    KD_mean = mean(Norm[Background == "KD"], na.rm = TRUE),
    FC = KD_mean / WT_mean,
    
    p_value = tryCatch(
      t.test(Norm ~ Background)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA
    ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    
    # nice labels
    FC_label = paste0(round(FC, 2), "x"),
    p_label = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "p < 0.001",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "p < 0.01",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "p < 0.05",
      TRUE ~ paste0("p = ", signif(p_adj, 2))
    ),
    
    label_full = paste0(FC_label, "\n", p_label)
  )
```


# Fig 2C - 328 Mutants DL assay

```{r}
group1_order <- c(
  "WT 328 Tether",
  "delRNA tether",
  "delN tether",
  "258 Tether",
  "204 Tether",
  "delPABP Tether"
)

df_group1 <- df %>%
  filter(Cell_Line == "WT_H295R", Conc_MSI2 == 25) %>%
  mutate(
    Nano_FF = NanoGlo / Firefly,
    construct_plot = case_when(
      MSI2_Exp %in% c("328_Tether", "WT_Tether", "FullLength_Tether") ~ "WT 328 Tether",
      MSI2_Exp == "delRNA_Tether" ~ "delRNA tether",
      MSI2_Exp == "delN_Tether" ~ "delN tether",
      MSI2_Exp == "258_Tether" ~ "258 Tether",
      MSI2_Exp == "204_Tether" ~ "204 Tether",
      MSI2_Exp == "delPABP_Tether" ~ "delPABP Tether",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Exp) %>%
  mutate(
    GFP_Tether_mean = mean(Nano_FF[MSI2_Exp == "GFP_Tether"], na.rm = TRUE),
    GFP_norm = Nano_FF / GFP_Tether_mean
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(construct_plot), is.finite(GFP_norm)) %>%
  mutate(construct_plot = factor(construct_plot, levels = group1_order))

df_group1 <- df_group1 %>% filter(Exp != "KAB157")

df_group1_summary <- df_group1 %>%
  group_by(construct_plot) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean = mean(GFP_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(GFP_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    FC_vs_GFP = mean,
    experiments = paste(sort(unique(Exp)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

group1_stats <- df_group1 %>%
  group_by(construct_plot) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = tryCatch(
      t.test(GFP_norm, mu = 1)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    sig_label = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  )

df_group1_plot <- df_group1_summary %>%
  left_join(group1_stats, by = "construct_plot") %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(round(FC_vs_GFP, 2), "x\n", sig_label)
  )

ggplot(df_group1_plot, aes(x = construct_plot, y = mean)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "red") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label, y = mean + sd + 0.2),
    size = 4
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "NanoLuc:Firefly normalized to GFP tether",
    title = "H295R tether assay"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave(here::here("figures", "fig2C_DL328mutants.pdf"))

```


# Fig 2E - 328 sufficiency DL assay

```{r}
group2_order <- c(
```

```{r}
ggplot(df_plot_kab142, aes(y = construct_plot, x = mean)) +

    aes(xmin = mean - sd, xmax = mean + sd),
    height = 0.2
  ) +

    size = 4

  labs(
    x = "GFP Norm. NanoLUC:FireflyLUC Ratio",
    y = "",
    title = "KAB142"
```

# Fig 2G, Supp 2F - PABP KD DL assay

```{r}
df_pabp <- df %>%
  filter(Exp == "KAB165")

df_pabp$Nano_FF <- df_pabp$NanoGlo/df_pabp$Firefly

df_pabp <- df_pabp %>% filter(Sample_Name2 != "Lipo")

df_pabp <- separate(df_pabp, col = "Sample_Name2", into = c("Protein", "siRNA2"), sep = "_", remove = F)


df_pabp <- df_pabp %>%
  mutate(
    Nano_FF_norm = Nano_FF / mean(Nano_FF[Sample_Name2 == "GFP_noSI"], na.rm = TRUE)
  )

ggplot(df_pabp, aes(x = Sample_Name2, y = Nano_FF_norm, fill = Protein)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", fun = "mean", color = "black", width = 0.7, position = position_dodge()) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_sdl, fun.args = list(mult = 1), 
               geom = "errorbar", color = "black", width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(0.7)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "",
    subtitle = "",
    y = "NanoLUC:FireflyLUC Ratio",
    x = ""
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkblue")


sampleList <- c("P1hi","P2hi", "conSI")

#filtered

ggplot(df_pabp %>% filter(siRNA2 %in% sampleList & Protein != "ntMSI2"), aes(x = Sample_Name2, y = Nano_FF_norm, fill = Protein)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", fun = "mean", color = "black", width = 0.7, position = position_dodge()) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_sdl, fun.args = list(mult = 1), 
               geom = "errorbar", color = "black", width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(0.7)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "",
    subtitle = "",
    y = "NanoLUC:FireflyLUC Ratio",
    x = ""
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkblue")

ggsave(here::here("figures", "fig2G_DLpabpKD.pdf"))

stats_pabp_long <- df_pabp %>%
  filter(siRNA2 %in% c("conSI", "P1hi", "P2hi")) %>%
  group_by(Protein) %>%
  summarise(
    p_P1hi_vs_conSI = tryCatch(
      t.test(
        Nano_FF_norm[siRNA2 == "P1hi"],
        Nano_FF_norm[siRNA2 == "conSI"]
      )$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    p_P2hi_vs_conSI = tryCatch(
      t.test(
        Nano_FF_norm[siRNA2 == "P2hi"],
        Nano_FF_norm[siRNA2 == "conSI"]
      )$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    FC_P1hi_vs_conSI = mean(Nano_FF_norm[siRNA2 == "P1hi"], na.rm = TRUE) /
                       mean(Nano_FF_norm[siRNA2 == "conSI"], na.rm = TRUE),
    FC_P2hi_vs_conSI = mean(Nano_FF_norm[siRNA2 == "P2hi"], na.rm = TRUE) /
                       mean(Nano_FF_norm[siRNA2 == "conSI"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_P1hi = p.adjust(p_P1hi_vs_conSI, method = "BH"),
    p_adj_P2hi = p.adjust(p_P2hi_vs_conSI, method = "BH")
  )

stats_pabp_long

stats_pabp_labels <- stats_pabp_long %>%
  select(Protein,
         FC_P1hi_vs_conSI, p_adj_P1hi,
         FC_P2hi_vs_conSI, p_adj_P2hi) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Protein,
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    siRNA2 = case_when(
      grepl("P1hi", metric) ~ "P1hi",
      grepl("P2hi", metric) ~ "P2hi"
    ),
    type = case_when(
      grepl("^FC", metric) ~ "FC",
      grepl("^p_adj", metric) ~ "p_adj"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-metric) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(
      round(FC, 2), "x\n",
      case_when(
        p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ "ns"
      )
    )
  )

df_pabp_labels <- df_pabp_summary %>%
  left_join(stats_pabp_labels, by = c("Protein", "siRNA2")) %>%
  mutate(
    label = ifelse(siRNA2 == "conSI", "", label)
  )

ggplot(df_pabp_summary, aes(x = Protein, y = mean, fill = siRNA2)) +
  geom_col(
    color = "black",
    width = 0.7,
    position = position_dodge(0.8)
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd),
    width = 0.2,
    position = position_dodge(0.8)
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = df_pabp_labels,
    aes(label = label, y = mean + sd + 0.15),
    position = position_dodge(0.8),
    size = 4
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    y = "NanoLUC:FireflyLUC Ratio",
    x = ""
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkblue")


ggsave(here::here("figures", "fig2G_DLpabpKD.pdf"))
```

#Supp Fig 2F - qPCR PABP KD

```{r}
OD3 <- read_xlsx(here::here("data", "KAB165_qPCRII.xlsx"))

OD3 <- OD3 %>% separate(col = "Sample", into = c("Sample3", "Primer", "RT"), sep = "_" )
OD3 <- OD3 %>% tidyr::unite("Sample", c("Sample3", "RT"), remove = FALSE)

OD3 <- OD3 %>% filter(Sample2 != "Sample15" & Sample2 != "Sample16")

#need to get a delta for PABP vs GAPDH for each sample..

OD_ratio <- OD3 %>% na.omit() %>% dplyr::select(c(RT, Primer, Cq, Sample3, Sample2)) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Primer, values_from = Cq, values_fn = mean)

OD_ratio$delta_PB_GP <- OD_ratio$GAPDH - OD_ratio$PABP

OD_ratio2 <- OD_ratio %>% filter(RT == "RT")


OD_ratio2 <- OD_ratio2 %>% separate(col = "Sample2", into = c("Protein", "siRNA"), sep = "_" ) %>% na.omit()
#now do delta delta.. compare to each noSI?




#2^(-ΔΔCt)

OD_ratio2 <- OD_ratio2 %>% group_by(Protein) %>% mutate(delta_delta = delta_PB_GP - delta_PB_GP[siRNA == "conSI"])

OD_ratio2$expression <- 2^-(OD_ratio2$delta_delta)

OD_ratio2$percent_KD <- (1 - OD_ratio2$expression) * 100

OD_ratio2$siRNA <- factor(OD_ratio2$siRNA, levels = c("noSI", "conSI", "P1lo", "P1hi", "P2lo", "P2hi"))

ggbarplot(data = OD_ratio2, x = "siRNA",  y = "expression") + geom_point() +
  labs(title = "",
      y = "Fold Change Expression - PABP KD",
      x = "siRNA") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 1) + facet_grid(~Protein) + theme_minimal()

ggbarplot(data = OD_ratio2 %>% filter(siRNA %in% sampleList & Protein != "ntMSI2"), x = "siRNA",  y = "expression") + geom_point() +
  labs(title = "",
      y = "Fold Change Expression - PABP KD",
      x = "siRNA") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 1) + facet_grid(~Protein) + theme_minimal()

ggsave(here::here("figures", "suppfig2F_qPCRpabpKD.pdf"))
```

# Fig 4E - 324 mutants DL assay

```{r}
plot_order <- c(
  "328 tether",
  "324 tether",
  "delN tether",
  "324_Unique",
  "324_PBDplusUnique"
)

df_h295r <- df %>%
  filter(Cell_Line == "WT_H295R" & Conc_MSI2 == 25) %>%
  mutate(
    Nano_FF = NanoGlo / Firefly,
    construct_plot = case_when(
      MSI2_Exp %in% c("328_Tether", "WT_Tether", "FullLength_Tether", "Full length_Tether") ~ "328 tether",
      MSI2_Exp == "324_Tether" ~ "324 tether",
      MSI2_Exp == "delN_Tether" ~ "delN tether",
      MSI2_Exp == "324-Unique_Tether" ~ "324_Unique",
      MSI2_Exp == "324-PBDplusUnique_Tether" ~ "324_PBDplusUnique",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Exp) %>%
  mutate(
    GFP_Tether_mean = mean(Nano_FF[MSI2_Exp == "GFP_Tether"], na.rm = TRUE),
    GFP_norm = Nano_FF / GFP_Tether_mean
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(construct_plot)) %>%
  mutate(construct_plot = factor(construct_plot, levels = plot_order))

df_h295r_summary <- df_h295r %>%
  group_by(construct_plot) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean = mean(GFP_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(GFP_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    experiments = paste(sort(unique(Exp)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

df_h295r_summary

ggplot(df_h295r_summary, aes(x = construct_plot, y = mean)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "NanoLuc:Firefly normalized to GFP tether",
    title = "H295R tether assay"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

stats_df <- df_h295r %>%
  group_by(construct_plot) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = tryCatch(
      t.test(GFP_norm, mu = 1)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    label = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  )

df_plot <- df_h295r_summary %>%
  left_join(stats_df, by = "construct_plot")

df_plot <- df_plot %>%
  mutate(
    mean_log2 = log2(mean),
    ymin_log2 = log2(mean - sd),
    ymax_log2 = log2(mean + sd)
  )

ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = construct_plot, y = mean_log2)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = ymin_log2, ymax = ymax_log2),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red") +  # GFP baseline (log2(1)=0)
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label, y = ymax_log2 + 0.2),
    size = 5
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "log2(NanoLuc:Firefly normalized to GFP tether)",
    title = "H295R tether assay"
  ) +
```

# Figure 6B - DL assay, all cell lines

```{r}
plot_order <- c(
  "MSI2-328",
  "delPBD",
  "MSI2-324",
  "delN"
)

df_multi <- df %>%
  filter(Conc_MSI2 == 25, Reporter == "BoxB") %>%
  mutate(
    Nano_FF = NanoGlo / Firefly,
    
    construct_plot = case_when(
      MSI2_Exp == "GFP_Tether" ~ "GFP tether",
      MSI2_Exp %in% c("328_Tether", "WT_Tether", "FullLength_Tether") ~ "MSI2-328",
      MSI2_Exp == "324_Tether" ~ "MSI2-324",
      MSI2_Exp %in% c("delPBD_Tether", "delPABP_Tether") ~ "delPBD",
      MSI2_Exp == "delN_Tether" ~ "delN",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(construct_plot)) %>%
  group_by(Exp, Cell_Line) %>%
  mutate(
    GFP_mean = mean(Nano_FF[construct_plot == "GFP tether"], na.rm = TRUE),
    GFP_norm = Nano_FF / GFP_mean
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(construct_plot != "GFP tether")

df_multi <- df_multi %>%
  mutate(
    Cell = case_when(
      str_detect(Cell_Line, "MCF7") ~ "MCF7",
      str_detect(Cell_Line, "HeLa") ~ "HeLa",
      str_detect(Cell_Line, "HEK") ~ "HEK293FT",
      str_detect(Cell_Line, "H295R") ~ "H295R",
      TRUE ~ Cell_Line
    )
  )

df_summary <- df_multi %>%
  group_by(construct_plot, Cell) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(GFP_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(GFP_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    construct_plot = factor(construct_plot, levels = plot_order)
  )

stats_df <- df_multi %>%
  group_by(construct_plot, Cell) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = tryCatch(
      t.test(GFP_norm, mu = 1)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    label = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "N.S."
    )
  )

df_plot <- df_summary %>%
  left_join(stats_df, by = c("construct_plot", "Cell"))


df_domain <- df_plot %>%
  filter(construct_plot %in% c("MSI2-328", "delPBD", "MSI2-324", "delN")) %>%
  mutate(
    comparison = case_when(
      construct_plot %in% c("MSI2-328", "delPBD") ~ "328 / delPBD",
      construct_plot %in% c("MSI2-324", "delN") ~ "324 / delN"
    ),
    construct_plot = factor(
      construct_plot,
      levels = c("MSI2-328", "delPBD", "MSI2-324", "delN")
    )
  )

ggplot(df_domain, aes(x = Cell, y = mean, fill = construct_plot)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), color = "black", width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd),
    width = 0.2,
    position = position_dodge(0.8)
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "red") +
  facet_wrap(~comparison, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "MSI2-328" = "#377EB8",
      "delPBD"   = "#A6CEE3",
      "MSI2-324" = "#E69F00",
      "delN"     = "#FDD49E"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "GFP Norm. NanoLUC:FireflyLUC Ratio",
    fill = ""
  )
```
